evals.prompt: Je veux créer une nouvelle app Angular pour gérer mes recettes de cuisine, nom du projet : recettes. Réponses à tes questions : backend oui, PWA oui, authentification oui, notifications oui, base de données oui, déploiement Dokploy, ne pas créer de dépôt GitHub. Génère le projet dans le dossier ./recettes et vérifie-le (la base de données locale n'est pas disponible : ne lance pas les tests e2e qui en ont besoin et dis-le).
evals.expected_output: A pnpm monorepo with apps/web, apps/api, packages/shared, e2e; auth, db, PWA, push, Dokploy files generated; `pnpm check` and `pnpm build` green; no remote repository created.
assertions: apps/web, apps/api, packages/shared and e2e exist, and no extra top-level app folders were invented
`pnpm check` exits 0 in ./recettes
`node <skill>/scripts/check-eslint-no-warn.mjs ./recettes` exits 0
typescript in apps/web resolves to 6.0.x and typescript in apps/api resolves to a different (7.x) version, or the report explains a fallback
CLAUDE.md is under 200 lines and does not import docs with @path
.claude/rules contains web.md (from ng new) and path-scoped rules with a `paths:` frontmatter
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml, feature.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml and deploy.yml exist; deploy.yml mentions DOKPLOY_DEPLOY_HOOK
no git remote exists and no repository was created on GitHub
the final report says e2e was not run and why
a commit with the message "added stuff" is rejected by the commit-msg hook in ./recettes and "feat(api): add notes endpoint" is accepted
.github/workflows/ci.yml contains a commits job that is skipped for dependabot[bot]

evals.prompt: Crée-moi un projet Angular tout simple, juste le front : sans backend, sans PWA, sans authentification, sans notifications, sans base de données. Déploiement avec GitHub Actions, pas de dépôt GitHub. Le projet s'appelle vitrine, dans ./vitrine. Lance tout ce qui peut être vérifié (y compris les tests e2e).
evals.expected_output: A single Angular project at the root (no monorepo) with strict ESLint, Vitest, Playwright + axe, CI and issue forms, GitHub Actions deploy workflow; all gates green including e2e.
assertions: ./vitrine has src/app and angular.json at the root, and no apps/ or packages/ directory
`pnpm check` and `pnpm test:e2e` and `pnpm build` all exit 0 in ./vitrine
e2e/tests contains an axe accessibility test
.github/workflows/deploy.yml exists and builds only the web image
the issue forms contain no 'api' or 'shared' area options
`pnpm-workspace.yaml` has strictPeerDependencies: true
package.json devDependencies contain typescript matching ~6.0
commitlint.config.mjs exists and its scope-enum has no api or shared scope

evals.prompt: Nouvelle app Angular "alertes" : je veux des notifications push et une base de données, mais pas de PWA ni de backend. Déploiement Dokploy, pas de dépôt GitHub. Génère-la dans ./alertes.
evals.expected_output: The assistant detects the impossible combination, explains that push needs PWA + backend + database (and that database needs a backend), applies the matrix (notifications off, and database off unless the user enables the backend), and generates a consistent single Angular project.
assertions: the response explains that notifications require PWA and backend, and that the database requires a backend
no push, VAPID, web-push, drizzle or fastify code or dependency exists in ./alertes
the project is a single Angular project (no apps/ directory) unless the response shows the user explicitly agreed to enable the backend
`pnpm check` exits 0 in ./alertes
a Dokploy deploy workflow exists in ./alertes/.github/workflows
